steps: Select a payment method and enter your payment details.
Your voucher is issued as soon as the payment is completed.
You can find purchased vouchers in MY Shopping, and also receive them on LINE if you add Unifi as a friend.
Once the payment is confirmed, 5% cashback on the payment amount is also given as points.

refund.title: Please check the cancellation and refund conditions for each product before purchasing.
refund.description: If the voucher has not been used, you can receive a 100% refund within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period has passed or if the voucher has been partially used.
